prompt:
The image shows face-up playing cards arranged as a hand, labeled hands, or labeled candidate cards. Use blackjack values: number cards count as printed, J/Q/K count as 10, and each Ace counts as 11 unless that would bust, then it counts as 1. A bust hand is worse than any non-bust hand. Select the option letter for the best labeled blackjack hand.
Annotation format: set "annotation" to an array of bounding boxes [x0, y0, x1, y1] for every card in the winning blackjack hand.
Answer format: set "answer" to only the winning blackjack hand option letter.
Example JSON:
{"annotation":[[120,80,200,190],[220,80,300,190],[320,80,400,190]],"answer":"B"}
